title: An invariant modification of the bilinear form test
summary: The invariance properties of certain likelihood-based asymptotic tests as well as their extensions for M-estimation, estimating functions and the generalized method of moments have been well studied. The simulation study reported in Crudu and Osorio [Econ. Lett. 187: 108885, 2020] shows that the bilinear form test is not invariant to one-to-one transformations of the parameter space.
